title: Planning and Writing Simple Sentences
introduction: Arrange words into clear sentences and link related ideas.
definition: Arrange words into clear sentences and link related ideas.
rules: Choose a subject and a verb; add details when needed.
Read your sentence again to check word order, capitals and punctuation.

examples.question: Put in order: on Sundays / play / We
steps: Put the subject first, then the verb and time phrase.

examples.question: Put in order: a red hat / wears / She
steps: Put the subject before the verb and object.

exercises.question: Put in order: on Sundays / play / We
exercises.solution: Put the subject first, then the verb and time phrase.

exercises.question: Put in order: a red hat / wears / She
exercises.solution: Put the subject before the verb and object.

exercises.question: Join: I like apples ___ oranges. (and or is)
Complete: I am tired ___ I ran. (because or and)
Put in order: two chairs / There are / in the room
exercises.answer: There are two chairs in the room.
exercises.solution: Start with There are, then the plural noun and place.

exercises.question: Put in order: swimming / is / Ben
exercises.solution: Use subject, be and the -ing verb.

summary: Arrange words into clear sentences and link related ideas. Choose a subject and a verb; add details when needed.
